entities.name: Posteroseptal RF alters activation
observations: In 3 human electrophysiology patients, initially unsuccessful posteroseptal RF applications shifted earliest retrograde atrial activation from the coronary sinus ostium to the right atrial free wall in 2 patients and to the distal coronary sinus in 1 patient.
Further RF was required to eliminate pathway conduction or tachycardia, indicating activation-sequence alteration rather than simple pathway elimination.

entities.name: RF-related atrial conduction change
observations: A human right-posteroseptal case report described altered intra-atrial activation or conduction after extensive RF near the tricuspid annulus following failed ablation, complicating subsequent pathway localization.
Evidence is case-based and provides limited quantitative outcome detail.
